legend-german-clock-route.slogan: German Clock Route – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-german-clock-route.story: official tourism route. Black Forest, craft villages, waterfalls. 62 km from Villingen-Schwenningen to Furtwangen, about 1 h 08 of riding. The stops in between: Triberg and Titisee-Neustadt. The highest point is about 950 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
